description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取恒生行业的港股通持仓（南向）数据。可按行业代码批量查询返回每日的内资持仓金额、内资净买入金额、内资持仓金额占市值比例。当用户想查询某行业每日的港股通买卖明细、追踪外资每日的增减持操作时，调用此接口。
description.en: Fetch time-series southbound holding data for HSI industry indices, returning daily holding amount and domestic capital market cap ratio within a date range. Returns chronological records. Used when tracking southbound capital buying patterns in HSI industries, analyzing sector-level foreign positioning, or backtesting sector timing strategies.

descriptions: 结束信息日期。用于获取时间范围内的数据，默认值为今天结束。
